Package neqsim.process.measurementdevice

Class NozzleFlowMeter

java.lang.Object
neqsim.util.NamedBaseClass
neqsim.process.measurementdevice.MeasurementDeviceBaseClass
neqsim.process.measurementdevice.StreamMeasurementDeviceBaseClass
neqsim.process.measurementdevice.DifferentialPressureFlowMeter
neqsim.process.measurementdevice.NozzleFlowMeter
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, TransientStateParticipant<DifferentialPressureFlowMeter.DifferentialPressureFlowMeterState>, MeasurementDeviceInterface, ProcessElementInterface, NamedInterface
public class NozzleFlowMeter extends DifferentialPressureFlowMeter
Nozzle differential-pressure flow meter following ISO 5167-1 and ISO 5167-3.

ISO 5167-3 covers four nozzle sub-types, selected with setNozzleType(NozzleType), each with its own discharge-coefficient formula but sharing the same isentropic expansibility factor, ExpansibilityModel.ISENTROPIC:

  • NozzleFlowMeter.NozzleType.ISA_1932 — ISO 5167-3 Formula (5).
  • NozzleFlowMeter.NozzleType.LONG_RADIUS — ISO 5167-3 Formula (10).
  • NozzleFlowMeter.NozzleType.THROAT_TAPPED — ISO 5167-3 Formulae (13) and (14).
  • NozzleFlowMeter.NozzleType.VENTURI_NOZZLE — ISO 5167-3 Formula (19), Reynolds-number independent.

    • calcDischargeCoefficient

      protected double calcDischargeCoefficient(double beta, double reynoldsD)
      Calculates the discharge coefficient C for the given diameter ratio and pipe Reynolds number. Devices whose coefficient does not depend on the Reynolds number (classical Venturi tubes, cone and wedge meters) simply ignore the second argument.
      Specified by:
      calcDischargeCoefficient in class DifferentialPressureFlowMeter
      Parameters:
      beta - diameter ratio d/D [-]
      reynoldsD - pipe Reynolds number Re,D [-]; an initial estimate of 1.0e6 is used for the first iteration
      Returns:
      discharge coefficient C [-]

    • calcThroatTappedDischargeCoefficient

      private double calcThroatTappedDischargeCoefficient(double reynoldsThroat)
      Calculates the throat-tapped flow nozzle discharge coefficient, ISO 5167-3 Formulae (13) and (14).
      Parameters:
      reynoldsThroat - throat Reynolds number Re,d [-]
      Returns:
      discharge coefficient C [-], or NaN when Re,d < 400000 (the 1 - 400000 / Re,d term of Formula (13)/(14) would otherwise go negative, outside the domain of a non-integer power)
